command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P5.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The assembled part exercises both prefix rules: `movw %bx,%ax` is 66 89 d8 and `movw %si,%di` is 66 89 f7 (0x66 as template byte 0); `movb %ah,%ch` is 88 e5 while `movb %spl,%bpl` is 40 88 e5, the same ModRM byte with a different register set; `movb %al,%cl` is the REX-less low-byte row and `movb %ah,%ah` keeps number 4 as a high byte on both sides. The appended 66 8b c3 is the `8B` direction at 16 bits, which llvm-mc will not select from a mnemonic, so it is verified by `llvm-mc -disassemble`, which prints `movw %bx, %ax`.
